caption: The drawing depicts the detailed bust of a horse’s head, shown in three-quarters view facing to the right. The artwork is rendered in grayscale, using various shades of black, gray, and white. The horse’s mouth is open, nostrils flared, and eyes wide, capturing a dynamic expression. The mane is long and wavy, flowing with numerous dark and light contrasts to emphasize its volume and texture. At the base of the horse’s neck, the mane appears to form ribbon-like shapes. The overall composition is tightly focused on the horse’s head and upper neck, without any background elements, occupying most of the space within the frame. The shading is smooth and carefully done, highlighting contours, muscle definition, and the intricate details of the mane. The background is plain and light, providing contrast to the darker values of the horse.
title: Decorative Horse's Head
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
